about: B73 planted errors (Part 2), written before the checker existed. Each one edits a faithful text (data/faithful.json) to plant exactly one error. Types: name, number, place, object, cause, motive, image, belief, modern (our word, not theirs: PRE-38), hidden (a fact the tellers can't know: PRE-14), soften, omit, hedge (dark events: RSK-17), role (who did what), contradiction (wrong statement made only of words in the data).
